image_description: A close-up shot of an elaborate, multi-strand statement necklace displayed on a white mannequin bust. The necklace features a complex mix of materials including green seed beads, larger faceted amber and pink gemstones, pearls, and metallic filigree components. A large, dark purple oval stone set in a silver-tone bezel serves as the central pendant. The construction appears to be wire-wrapped or strung on multiple threads rather than a simple chain.
